query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_usuarios,
  SUM(CASE WHEN salario IS NOT NULL AND salario > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as con_salario,
  SUM(CASE WHEN nivelJerarquico IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as con_nivel
FROM users;
